label: Unrevealed map fog tile
derivation: byte-exact copy; runtime maps one native image to one 32-by-32 cell with nearest filtering
presentation_contract: The tile covers every projected map cell withheld by exploration visibility: never-seen cells on authored LOS maps and non-LOS cells outside both the current Classic window and remembered discovery. Save-owned seen or revealed cells render at normal fidelity; the decorative stage surround remains only outside projected map cells.
